title: os migrate organization-ownership has no step for the inventory's organization-presentational-promotion category: views saved through the v17 /meta door stay unserved at v18, and column-drops blocks on sys_metadata forever
body:
Blocked-by: #15211

Filing gate **① a product defect with a public door** (class b, a declared contract with no consumer). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`) from cloud#2868's dev report (objectstack-ai/cloud#2868 `6161163819`), measured at framework pin `5b68524b93` in a rehearsal on copies of two v17 tenant databases (an AI environment and a plain one), the cloud#2867 method. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's. **Priority p1: it blocks cloud's v18 move** (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), under the maintainer's rule that a platform defect affecting cloud's v18 upgrade is filed to its lane at high priority.

**Dedupe:** the same listing as the issue filed beside this one; no hit.

## What happens
- **The command:** the same apply, on a copy of the AI environment's v17 tenant database, with the built-in-position blocker (filed beside this one) stood in by a rig-only row delete.
- **The result:** `column-drops` blocks with: "sys_metadata.organization_id is not dropped: 4 row(s) of \"organization-scoped rows of the five presentational types — promoted to environment rows (ruling record 6020163868, A)…\". Those rows need their own step."
- **The steps:** `CEREMONY_STEPS` (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts:101`, the same on `main` `0add8a49ce`) holds no step that promotes them.
- **What the customer sees:** a view saved through the v17 `/meta` door stays unserved at v18. In rehearsal item I8 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2867), `GET /meta/view/rh7k_project.list` answers 404, and `sys_metadata` never completes its fate.

## Contract
The inventory's own category `organization-presentational-promotion` (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts:290`) and ruling record `6020163868` A promise the promotion. No step consumes it.

## Ask
The ceremony runs the promotion the inventory declares, before `column-drops`, so the five presentational types saved at the organization layer become environment rows.

**Seam:** `spec:ceremony inventory category organization-presentational-promotion` → consumer: none.

Related: #15211 · #22937 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2867 (I8) · objectstack-ai/cloud#2868.
